note: What was happening behind lit windows in 15 West. room = floor number + position on that floor, left to right from 00 to 21 (room 605 = floor 6, position 05). Each story sits in the window with its room number. Rooms ending in 04, 08 and 16 are wall, not windows. Several stories can share a room. Each story card takes the color of its window.

stories.text: Re-sewing a hem for the third time. Crit is at 9 a.m. and the seam keeps puckering.
Glazing test tiles. The kiln opens at 8 a.m.
Psychology midterm tomorrow. Just started studying.
400 words in to my mid term paper. Need 1,500.
Making my portfolio site. Again.
Rendering my thesis model. 38% done.
Laundry’s in. Watching it spin like it’s TV.
Re-exporting my PDF portfolio for the fourth time.
Listening to music and chilling.
Making instant ramen in the kettle again.
Gluing foam core. Fumes are killing me.
Kerning one headline for an hour.
Calling my friends back home.
My roommate’s asleep, so I’m drawing under my phone light.
Watching a lecture at 2x speed.
Playing FIFA.
Texting my sister. It’s morning where she is.
Can’t sleep. Rearranging my room instead.
Preparing for Internship Connect.
Getting ready to go to the Design Centre before the print lab closes.
Calling my Mom.
Editing my short film. Third cut.
Group chat says nobody’s done. Makes me feel better.
Photographing my work while the light’s even.
Typing my artist statement. Deleting it. Typing again.
Still weaving. 40 rows left.
Finally done. Leaving the light on a bit longer.
Can’t stop scrolling. Should be sleeping. 8am tomorrow.
Getting ready for bed!
